name: R90-B01-while-false
cmd: while false; do python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; done
why: The false while condition prevents any iteration of the bound command.

name: R90-B02-true-if-both-dead
cmd: if true; then (exit 0; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json); else python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; fi
why: The selected then subshell exits before its sweep; the else sweep is unselected.

name: R90-B03-case-unmatched
cmd: case cached in fresh) python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json;; esac
why: The literal subject cached cannot select the fresh arm containing the sweep.

name: R90-B04-true-and-exiting-group
why: Although true selects the right group, its exit prevents the bound command from running.

name: R90-B05-colon-or
why: The argument-free colon builtin succeeds, skipping the OR fallback sweep.

name: R90-B06-subshell-early-exit
why: An unconditional subshell exit occurs before the sweep in the same subshell.

name: R90-B07-status-three-and
why: The status-three subshell prevents evaluation of the AND right operand.

name: R90-B08-break-then-exit
cmd: (while :; do break; done; exit 0; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json)
why: The loop finishes through break, but an intervening exit makes the following sweep unreachable.

name: R90-B09-until-true
cmd: until true; do python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; done
why: The successful until condition terminates the loop before its first body execution.

name: R90-B10-empty-for
cmd: for receipt in; do python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; done
why: The explicit empty for list supplies no iteration in which to run the sweep.

name: R90-B11-elif-takes-precedence
cmd: if false; then :; elif true; then printf 'cached\n'; else python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; fi
why: The successful elif selects its print arm, leaving the bound else arm unreachable.

name: R90-B12-case-selected-early-exit
cmd: (case cached in cached) exit 0; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json;; *) :;; esac)
why: The matching case arm exits its enclosing subshell before its bound sweep.

name: R90-B13-loop-break-before-sweep
cmd: while true; do break; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; done
why: The first loop statement breaks out before the sweep can run on any iteration.

name: R90-B14-negated-true-and
why: Negation makes true return failure for the AND list, skipping its bound right side.

name: R90-M01-plain
why: The exact bound path is the plain isolated Python script operand.

name: R90-M02-pipeline-tail
why: The pipeline tail directly invokes the bound script; piping stdin does not remove its binding.

name: R90-M03-cd-sub
why: After a successful cd, the exact bound path remains a script operand; cwd provenance is not execution proof.

name: R90-M04-timeout-thirty
why: The timeout wrapper delegates to Python with the exact bound script operand.
